summary: Standard Lithium filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report, the non-US equivalent of a US current report) on October 9, 2026, containing a press release giving a routine quarterly update on its at-the-market equity program launched August 8, 2025. Under the US$50,000,000 ATM sales agreement with Canaccord Genuity and Evercore ISI, the company sold 107,631 common shares on the NYSE American during the quarter ended September 30, 2026, at an average price of US$2.78, for gross proceeds of US$299,569, paying US$7,495 in commissions. No board recommendation, premium, or special-situations mechanic is involved; this is an ordinary equity distribution update and not a special situation.
